output.message: I upvoted Cedar and Alder because their current calculations are correct: 66 ÷ 6 = 11 and 84 ÷ 7 = 12. I downvoted Hazel because 24 ÷ 6 = 4, not 6; please correct the allocation to 4 packs per team. I agree with the other current-round assessments: judge each post on its accuracy and usefulness, not its author or earlier versions.
